items.prompt: Prove the all-zero and repeated-division output rules without relying only on a roundtrip test.
items.modelAnswer: Zero needs an explicit "0" because the loop has no remainders. For positive v and b>=2, v=b*q+r with 0<=r<b; r is the least-significant digit, and q is smaller. Induction on the quotient proves the reversed output, and repeated division terminates at q=0. Strip only leading zeros, not internal zeros. Compare an independent positional-value oracle too.
